items.power_text: Your first dodge after entering combat leaves behind a very small warning cone. Enemies who ignore it are briefly staggered.
items.description: The cone is not legally binding, but it is extremely judgmental.

items.power_text: Every third hit marks the target as Formally Notified. The next heavy hit detonates the notice.
items.description: Filed in triplicate. One copy is already inside the monster.

items.power_text: Standing in a hazard for two seconds grants a cleansing pulse and stacking damage until you leave it.
items.description: It insists the water was like this when it arrived.
